title: Compass with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- outer compass case: brass/gold ring -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='42' fill='#C8912A'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='42' fill='none' stroke='#F2D06B' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- inner face: cream white -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='34' fill='#F4E9C8'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='34' fill='none' stroke='#A8721F' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- tick marks -->
  <g stroke='#8A5E1A' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <line x1='50' y1='20' x2='50' y2='26'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='74' x2='50' y2='80'/>
    <line x1='20' y1='50' x2='26' y2='50'/>
    <line x1='74' y1='50' x2='80' y2='50'/>
  </g>
  <!-- compass needle: red north, blue south, pivoting diagonally -->
  <g transform='rotate(-30 50 50)'>
    <polygon points='50,22 44,50 50,50' fill='#E8402A' stroke='#FF8A6E' stroke-width='1'/>
    <polygon points='50,22 56,50 50,50' fill='#FF6B4A' stroke='#FFB39E' stroke-width='1'/>
    <polygon points='50,78 44,50 50,50' fill='#3A5FCC' stroke='#8FA8F0' stroke-width='1'/>
    <polygon points='50,78 56,50 50,50' fill='#5B7BE0' stroke='#A9BEF5' stroke-width='1'/>
  </g>
  <!-- center pivot -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='4' fill='#C8912A'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='2' fill='#F2D06B'/>
  <!-- smiling face on lower face area -->
  <g fill='#5A3A0E'>
    <circle cx='38' cy='60' r='3'/>
    <circle cx='62' cy='60' r='3'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#5A3A0E'>
    <circle cx='39' cy='59' r='1' fill='#FFF6DC'/>
    <circle cx='63' cy='59' r='1' fill='#FFF6DC'/>
  </g>
  <path d='M38 68 Q50 76 62 68' fill='none' stroke='#5A3A0E' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheek blush -->
  <circle cx='31' cy='66' r='3' fill='#F29A8A' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='69' cy='66' r='3' fill='#F29A8A' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- little ring loop on top -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='12' r='5' fill='none' stroke='#F2D06B' stroke-width='3'/>
</svg>
